name: Kilimatembo School
quote: “Kilimatembo is dedicated to creating a brighter future for their students.”
description:
Tanzania

In 1976, Kilimatembo school officially opened its doors to students in rural Tanzania. Since then, the school has been providing education to local children to pave the way for a brighter future. Kilimatembo emphasises the importance of conservation and environmental education; encouraging children to participate in numerous nature-based activities, including tree planting and caring for plants in the school’s garden.

The Problem

Remote and isolated, Kilimatembo is a two-hour drive from the nearest major city. This means that resources are often scarce. Without regular funding, supplies like school books, clean drinking water and even salary and accommodation for teachers cannot be sustained. Without these essential tools, opportunities for the children at Kilimatembo are considerably limited.

The Solution

Regular donations will assist the maintaining of Kilimatembo school so it can continue to provide children with the education they deserve. This means acquiring water tanks for clean drinking water, a school kitchen, an ICT room, teacher accommodation, as well as computers, books and games for the children to use.

What difference will your money make?

$80 will purchase 10 new textbooks.

$315 will cover a teacher’s salary for a month.  

$1,500 will provide the school with two new computers.
